subject: [hw] DONE V18
body:
V18 (NEON three registers of the same length) is implemented and host-tested. No phone, no publish, no vendor bytes copied.

Last lines of bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v18/run_tests.sh (ASan+UBSan -O1 build/run, then plain -O2; identical):
    V18: 2790 cases, 2949 oracle words, sweep ok=56088 undef=164908
    N2TEST V18 PASS 225740/225740
    V18-IOS n2a32_neon_3same.c compiles for arm64-apple-ios16.0 with zero warnings
    V18-VENDOR PASS every class mnemonic used by the vendor objects is implemented

Implemented in emu/n2a32_neon_3same.c (class = A32 1111001U 0Dsize Vn Vd opc NQM bit4 Vm, i.e. bit23==0, D and Q forms incl. Q8-Q15):
VADD VSUB (i8/16/32/64), VHADD VHSUB VRHADD (s/u 8/16/32), VQADD VQSUB (s/u 8/16/32/64), VCGT VCGE (s/u), VCEQ VTST, VSHL VQSHL VRSHL VQRSHL (s/u 8/16/32/64, shift = signed byte of Vn, negative = right), VMAX VMIN VABD VABA (s/u), VMUL (i + p8), VMLA VMLS (i), VQDMULH VQRDMULH (s16/s32), VPADD VPMAX VPMIN (D form, as encoded), VAND VBIC VORR VORN VEOR VBSL VBIT VBIF; float32 VADD VSUB VMUL VMLA VMLS VFMA VFMS VCEQ VCGE VCGT VACGE VACGT VMAX VMIN VMAXNM VMINNM VABD VRECPS VRSQRTS VPADD VPMAX VPMIN, with the standard FPSCR value (RNE, DN=1 -> default NaN, FZ=1; VMLA/VMLS round the product, VFMA/VFMS fused; VRECPS/VRSQRTS with the ARM ARM 0*inf special cases). QC is FPSCR bit 27 (and c->q, the same architectural bit, so MRS APSR and VMRS agree).

Tests: 332 forms x 8 generated cases (>=6 per allocated form, checked; QC=1 and QC=0 required for every saturating form) + 134 hand-derived golden cases (VQADD/VQSUB saturation incl. 64-bit, VRHADD/VRSHL/VQRSHL rounding and shift -128, VQDMULH/VQRDMULH ties, VBSL/VBIT/VBIF masks, fused-vs-non-fused VFMA/VMLA 0x337ffffe vs 0x00000000, fmaxnm qnan/snan, pairwise order, Q forms, high D registers). All encodings from llvm-mc (generated assembly + hand-written golden_encodings.txt); expected values are literals from gen_cases.pys ref_model.py (ARM ARM pseudocode transcription, independent of the C) and from hand computation. Decode oracle: every (U,size,opc,bit4,Q) x 3 register patterns with llvm-mc as the oracle (996 must execute, 540 must be UNDEF, 1413 derived odd-Q-register words must be UNDEF). Sweep: 200000 random class words + 20000 outside, ASan/UBSan clean (only the destination D register(s) and QC may change; UNDEF leaves the struct byte-identical). Plus: 2M-case T01 fuzz with all classes linked is clean (fuzz: a32=1000000 t32=1000000 ok=96961 undef=674621 fault=1228418 budget=24) - this also verifies the two shift-by-64 fixes T01 asked for.

Acceptance: emu/test_v18/check_vendor_words.py (runs in run_tests.sh) walks the five vendor objects with llvm-objdump and keeps only 32-bit Thumb words whose A32 form is this class: 243 instructions, mnemonics vadd vorr vand vhadd vqrshl vrhadd vshl vbsl vbic vcgt vmax vmul vsub vtst - all implemented. So "no used mnemonic returned UNDEF" holds for the real encoding class, not just by mnemonic name (the D01 mnemonic list also contains vclt/vcle -> V20, vseleq -> V17 scalar, vabal/vabdl -> V19; posted to hw-d01).

Not done / open:
- No phone run (worker rules); no silicon oracle.
- FPSCR cumulative exception flags (IOC/DZC/OFC/UFC/IXC) are not set by float ops; only QC (as required).
- The SHA1/SHA256 three-register crypto space of this encoding class (SHA1C/P/M/SU0, SHA256H/H2/SU1) is deliberately N2A32_UNDEF: outside the V18 deliverable, and absent from the vendor objects (they use only the two-register SHA/AES forms, which are V20). A separate package if ever needed.
- Q form with an odd D-register number is UNPREDICTABLE and returns UNDEF (llvm-mc rejects those words too).
- T01 differential: gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v18/k18_neon_3same.c (13 kernels) is written and compile-checked but installing it is T01s directory; posted to hw-t01. Running the harness as-is: every kernel that contains only V18-class instructions (k_neon_vminmax/vmla/vmul/vshl/vcgtbit/vneg/vshrn) has 0 mismatches in all four ARM configurations; the remaining ARM-config failures are mixed V18/V19/V20 kernels, and V19s own k_neon_vsubl fails in arm-O2 too, so no V18 instruction could be isolated as a mismatch source. thumb-O0 failures are scalar T16/T32 code (no NEON at -O0).
- Not committed (workers do not touch git history).

Files (all new): gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_neon_3same.c; gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v18/{run_tests.sh,gen_cases.py,ref_model.py,gen_decode_oracle.py,golden_encodings.txt,golden_cases.inc,t_3same.c,check_vendor_words.py,k18_neon_3same.c,STATUS.md}; gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/V18/STATUS.md. Available for review findings.
